lessons.title: Bir olayı talep ve değerlendirme olarak yaz
lessons.objective: Aynı olayın doğrulanmış kısmını bir resmî yazıda çözüm talebine, değerlendirmede kanıta dayalı öneriye dönüştür.
lessons.situation: Bir pazarın kayıt masası yer değiştirdi. Katılımcılar, yeni yerin duyurulması ve bekleme süresinin değerlendirilmesi için iki ayrı metin hazırlıyor.
lessons.bridge: Talepte I would appreciate it if … ile tek eylem iste. Değerlendirmede Although … ile karşı kanıtı koru. Duyulan tahmini kaynak cümlesine bağla.

models.phrase: I would appreciate it if you could confirm where the desk will be on Saturday.
models.explanation: It, if yan tümcesine işaret eder. Could ile nazik ve yanıtlanabilir bir talep oluşur.

models.phrase: Although the queue was shorter at noon, the evening wait was not measured.
models.explanation: Although, karşı bilgiyi ana iddiayla birlikte tutar. İki yargı arasına ayrıca but ekleme.

concepts.label: Kibar talebin yapısını kur
concepts.incorrect: I would appreciate if you can confirm the route.
concepts.correct: I would appreciate it if you could confirm the route.
concepts.explanation: Bu modelde appreciate + it if + özne + could. İstenen eylemi açıkça yaz.
guided: Resmî istek: I would appreciate ___ if you could send the timetable. (it / that)
I would appreciate it if you ___ confirm the date. (could / to)
transfer: I would appreciate it if the office could ___ (reply / replying) in writing.
I would appreciate ___ if the manager could clarify the fee. (it / to)
delayed: I would appreciate it if you could ___ (check / checked) the entrance before Friday.
I would appreciate it if someone could ___ (share / shares) the revised notice.

concepts.label: Tavizden sonra karşı bilgiyi koru
concepts.incorrect: Although the sign was clear, but two people missed it.
concepts.correct: Although the sign was clear, two people missed it.
concepts.explanation: Although yan tümcesi ana tümceye bağlanır. Ana tümcede but eklemek gerekmez.
guided: Karşıtlık: ___ the desk moved, the fee stayed the same. (Although / Therefore)
Although the bus was late, the event started ___ time. (on / at)
transfer: ___ the reply arrived, it did not answer the question. (Although / Because) Karşıtlık.
Although the form was easy, its availability was ___ (limited / unlimited). It worked for one hour only.
delayed: Karşıtlık: ___ the first group finished, the second still needed help. (Although / Since)
Although the route looked clear, it ___ marked at the corner. (was not / will) Geçmiş olumsuz.

writing.prompt: Bir spor merkezinin yeni giriş düzeni hakkında 125–165 sözcük yaz. Önce sorumluya bilgi isteyen resmî mesaj, sonra üyeler için olayın kanıt ve sınırını içeren değerlendirme hazırla.
writing.sample:
Dear centre manager, I am writing about the evening entrance. Two members reached the side door on Monday and were unable to enter. Could you confirm which door will be staffed this Thursday and where visitors can ask for help? I would appreciate it if you could post the answer before our session. Kind regards, Deniz.

Member bulletin: The trial brought visitors closer to the changing rooms once they were inside. Although the side route was shorter, two people waited outside and had to call the main desk. The log covers one evening, and it does not tell us how many people turned away. We recommend a temporary sign and one staff member at the door before the next trial. Please tell the desk if you cannot enter so that the next review includes unsuccessful visits.
writing.revision: İki metindeki ilk cümlenin muhatabına hizmet ettiğinden emin ol. Gözlemi, bilinmeyen bilgiyi ve öneriyi ayrı bırak.
criteria: Değerlendirme dayanak, sınırlama ve öneriyi ayırır.

input.text:
Stallholder email. The West Street market has moved its arrival desk from the gate to the library entrance. I saw the change on a temporary sign after I had waited at the gate for ten minutes. Could you confirm where I should register next week? Some stallholders use the gate because it is close to the unloading area. I would appreciate it if you could put the new location in the booking email.

Market newsletter. Although lunchtime queues were shorter, the stallholder’s account shows that the move caused confusion before ten. The logged times include only people who reached the new desk. They give us a point of comparison for midday, but they cannot show how often somebody waited at the old entrance and left. Next week two volunteers will record questions at the gate and at the desk. The organisers have not decided whether to keep the relocation. They will report what each volunteer observes, how long the temporary signs remain visible, and what visitors who use the unloading bays say about the change. The booking team will also note whether putting the instructions in the confirmation email leads to fewer calls.
reading: What would help the market assess confusion at both locations?
Recording questions at the gate and the new desk
Only measuring people who arrived by noon
Moving the unloading area before collecting data
İki noktadaki gözlem ilk kaydın boşluğunu kapatabilir.
record questions at the gate and at the desk
input.transcript: Host: The newsletter says the lunchtime queue was shorter. Did the new desk save everyone time? Stallholder: It did not save me time. I went to the old gate first. I would appreciate it if the email could mention the library entrance next week. Volunteer: We can ask the booking team to add it. But some people do not read email on market day. Host: What will you do at the gate? Volunteer: Keep a sign there and write down the questions. We will compare that list with the questions at the new desk. We will not use the shorter queue as the only measure. Stallholder: Could you also check the unloading bay? People may look only at the gate from there. Host: Good point. We can add that location to the observation sheet without changing the market layout yet.
input.preparation: Talep edilen değişikliği ve ölçüm planını ayrı çıkar.
main: What does the stallholder ask the booking team to change?
Mention the library entrance in the email
Talep kayıt e-postasına yeni konumu eklemek.
email could mention the library entrance
detail: What will the volunteer keep at the old gate?
A sign and a record of questions
Keep a sign there and write down the questions

retry.text: Library feedback. The room opened ten minutes later than planned. Although the caretaker found a key, two visitors left before the door opened. Please confirm who will hold the spare key on Friday.
reading: Which claim can the report verify?
The room will open late on Friday
Bu kaynak sadece gözlenen ayrılmayı bildirir.
two visitors left before the door opened
retry.transcript: I am calling about the late train. I will follow up in writing to ask who will pay the replacement fare. We know the late train missed the connection, but we do not know how many passengers bought a new ticket.
retry.preparation: Talep ve belirsiz kalan veriyi ayır.
main: What will the letter ask about?
Who will pay the replacement fare
İstenen yanıt ücretin kimin tarafından ödeneceği.
who will pay the replacement fare
detail: How many passengers bought a new ticket
Whether the train missed the connection
how many passengers bought a new ticket

lessons.readingPurpose: Metinlerin muhatabını ve her metnin hangi bilgiyi neden içerdiğini karşılaştır.
lessons.readingUse: Bir ulaştırma olayı için aynı bilgiden iki farklı açılış yaz.
lessons.listeningUse: Gözlemi tahmin gibi, tahmini kesin bilgi gibi anlatmadan geri söyle.
lessons.speaking: Yeni bir konser mekânında erişim sorununu önce yetkiliye talep, sonra üyeye değerlendirme olarak aktar. Partner ilk veriyi bütün ziyaretçilere genellerse sınırı düzelt.

recovery.reading: Talep ile ölçüm planını ayrı satıra yaz.
recovery.main: Konuşmacının e-postaya eklenmesini istediği yeri dinle.
